derivation: or צְרֵדָתָה; apparently from an unused root meaning to pierce; puncture;

occurrences.text: And Jeroboam the son of Nebat, an Ephrathite of Zereda, Solomon’s servant, whose mother’s name was Zeruah, a widow woman, even he lifted up his hand against the king.
In the plain of Jordan did the king cast them, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zeredathah.
